574-1445-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-4871-7422.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

803-5411-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

333-728-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-728-5617.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

141-3899-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1086-1981-2415-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2438-3125-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2438-3125-5477.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-4986-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
2921-4986-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

856-4659-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Sword of the Paruns

5149-5200-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Transdimensional Bovine
Repeat.
5149-5200-7287.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

4038-5963-5986.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
4038-5963-5986.description:
Activate Marvin using Whisperer of the Wilds's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

2342-3835-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Repeat.

1418-1651-2638-4426-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-2638-4426-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-2638-4426-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2173-3661-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

632-2034-3621-5129-6791.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-6791.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

3750-6307.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures with total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Luxurious Locomotive.
Luxurious Locomotive does not have summoning sickness.
3750-6307.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive as an attacker.
Luxurious Locomotive triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1617-3388-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Moritte of the Frost on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-3388-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Moritte of the Frost to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1912-4222-4758-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1912-4222-4758-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

4186-4304-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen.
4186-4304-4875.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {2}{G}.
When Scurry Oak enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Conspiracy, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Conspiracy, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.

404-969-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
You control at least one creature token.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-969-3259.description:
Declare Ghired and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Ghired triggers, creating a token copy of a creature token you control that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token you control, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1355-1455-2733-5295.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Sanctum Weaver.
Activate the Sanctum Weaver token by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control to get infinite nonlegendary copies of that creature.

802-2649-2959-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can produce {1}{W/U}{R}{R}.
802-2649-2959-3821.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Heat Shimmer from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Peregrine Drake mutated creature.
The token Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Heat Shimmer from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Resolve a second trigger from step 7, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 7, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 7 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 6, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature token.
